name: Fine Moonstalker Pelt
summary: In southern Darkshore, mature moonstalkers carry the hides Terenthis needs. Their Fine Moonstalker Pelt is thick and healthy enough for an enchanted cloak that helps searchers pass the region’s hostile beasts unnoticed.

sections.title: Hides of the Pack Leaders
sections.body: Moonstalker sires and matriarchs have coats dense and healthy enough to yield a fine pelt. They hold territories along the Wildbend River and farther south toward Ashenvale’s borders, where they hunt with patience. Common moonstalkers prowl across Darkshore’s forests, but their hides are not fine enough.

sections.title: A Cloak of Deception
sections.body: Terenthis needs five intact pelts to make a cloak for travelers searching for the missing night elf Volcor. Nature magic binds the hides into an illusion that dulls the wearer’s presence to Darkshore’s wildlife. The cloak works only while its wearer avoids aggressive acts.

faq.q: What creatures yield a Fine Moonstalker Pelt?
faq.answer: Moonstalker sires and matriarchs yield Fine Moonstalker Pelts. Common and younger moonstalkers lack hides of sufficient quality.

faq.q: Where can the mature moonstalkers be found?
aliases: where are the sires and matriarchs
faq.answer: Mature moonstalkers live in southern Darkshore, especially along the Wildbend River and farther south toward Ashenvale.

faq.q: Why does Terenthis need these pelts?
faq.answer: Terenthis needs five pelts to make an enchanted cloak for travelers searching for the missing night elf Volcor. Its magic conceals a rescuer from predatory beasts.

faq.q: Does the finished cloak make you completely invisible?
faq.answer: The cloak does not make you completely invisible. Its natural illusion deters beasts, but actions beyond speaking to others can break the enchantment and dispel the disguise.

angles.text: As a hunter, tracking sires and matriarchs near the Wildbend River tests your skills against some of coastal Kalimdor’s fiercest predators.
As a night elf, you respect the moonstalkers’ sacred ferocity. Their hides are taken only in dire need, to aid fallen kin such as Volcor.
